content: Candidate 1 (id=1, reward=-0.8273) established strong gain 703 V/V with L=90nm. Candidate 2 showed that L=45nm collapses gain. Anchor on Candidate 1: needs higher UGBW and PM, slew rate is close (25/30). Cc, gm1 and second stage gm need tuning.

id 1: binding spec is UGBW (-0.567) and PM (-0.198). Cause: p2 = gm6/CL limits UGBW and degrades PM with CL=10pF. Lever: raise gm6 by shifting current into I2 (mn5=12, mn4=4) and widening mp3 (wp3=2u, mp3=18), balancing with wp1=2u, mp1=3. Trade-off: slightly higher current (190uA), but unlocks PM and UGBW.

Candidate 3 (from base 1) tested shifting current to I2 and lowering res: PM barely changed (40.1 -> 40.7 deg) and UGBW dropped (27.6 -> 25.8 MHz), SR degraded to 21.4 V/us. Lesson: lowering Itail hurts SR directly; reducing res removed zero lead. Reverting to base 1.

Candidate 5 (from base 4, res=8000) verified pole-zero cancellation: PM jumped from 39.7 to 69.27 deg (feasible!), UGBW rose to 64.1 MHz, SR=44 V/us, Gain=703 V/V. Only UGBW (-0.219 violation) remains to reach feasibility. Handing over to Diagnoser.

id 5: only UGBW (-0.219) violated. Margins: PM 69.3 deg (+9.3), SR 44 V/us (+14), gain 703 V/V. Lever: increase mn1 from 10 to 16 to raise gm1, and reduce Cc from 0.6p to 0.4p. Expected effect: UGBW 64 -> >100 MHz, achieving full feasibility (FoM > 0.3).

Candidate 8 confirmed parasitic loading: doubling wp3 and wp1 increased Cgs of mp3 loading stage 1 output, reducing PM from 59.6 to 52.6 deg. Candidate 6 remains current best (id=6, reward=-0.1303, PM=59.56 deg, UGBW=73.85 MHz). Handing over to Diagnoser.

id 6: binding specs UGBW (73.85 MHz) and PM (59.56 deg). Diff pair gates do not load node 2, so widening mn1 boosts gm1 without moving p2 down. Lever: wn1 2.0u->2.5u, mn1 16->20, res 9k->9.5k. Expected effect: gm1 +25%, UGBW -> >90 MHz, PM -> >60 deg.

Candidate 11 (id=11, reward=+0.0033) is on the brink of feasibility: UGBW=98.95 MHz (-0.005 violation), PM=58.71 deg (-0.011 violation). SR=59.3 V/us, Gain=670 V/V. Handing over to Diagnoser for the final feasibility push.
id 11: only 1.05 MHz UGBW and 1.29 deg PM needed for feasibility. Lever: mn1 18->20 for gm1 (+5% UGBW), res 7.5k->8.4k for additional zero lead (PM 58.7 -> >60 deg). Expect feasible candidate.

Candidate 14 (id=14) showed UGBW=111.6 MHz (excess margin), PM=58.04 deg. Candidate 12 (id=12, reward=+0.0057) is current best with UGBW=105.6 MHz and PM=58.58 deg. Only PM (-0.012) is binding. Handing over to Diagnoser.

id 12: UGBW=105.6 MHz (excess margin), PM=58.58 deg. Sensitivity shows Rc peaks near 7.9k-8.0k. Tuning mn1 20->19 drops UGBW to ~101 MHz (reducing unity-gain phase lag by ~1 deg), and res 8.4k->7.9k hits optimal zero lead. Expect PM > 60 deg, UGBW > 100 MHz -> FEASIBLE!

Candidate 17 (id=17, reward=0.6100, feasible=true) achieved full feasibility! Specs: PM=61.36 deg, UGBW=113.9 MHz, SR=57.3 V/us, Gain=653.1 V/V, Noise=0.0148 V. Feasibility phase complete in 17 simulations. Handing over to Diagnoser for Phase 2 (Optimization).

Candidate 17 optimization: current is 265uA (z=+0.139). Global lever: increase mn3 from 3 to 4 to reduce Itail and I2 by 25% while maintaining balance=4.0. Compensate UGBW by widening mn1 to 24 and wn1 to 2.5u. res=8000. Expect FoM to increase from 0.61 to >0.70.

Candidate 19 (id=19, reward=0.6477, feasible=true) is the optimal hand-sized design. All hard constraints met with tight margins (PM=61.63 deg, UGBW=102.4 MHz, SR=55.8 V/us). Current reduced to 245uA. Hand sizing has converged. Ready for Phase 3 (RL refinement).

RL phase used 550 simulations. Replay size=530, feasible designs grew to 16. Candidate 19 remains best overall (FoM=0.6477). Best RL design is candidate 138 (FoM=0.6305, I=226uA, PM=65.3 deg, UGBW=107.7 MHz, Gain=723.5 V/V) differing in wn5=0.75u, cap=0.8p, mp1=6/wp1=1.25u, mp3=18/wp3=1.25u. Handing over to Polish phase.

Polish Candidate 138: PM=65.3 deg and UGBW=107.7 MHz have excess margin; current is low (226uA), but area is large due to cap=0.8p. Lever: reduce cap to 0.6p and res=7600 to trim area. Expect FoM > 0.68.

Polish completed: Candidate 577 is the final champion with FoM=0.6857 (feasible=true). All specs passed with optimal margins: PM=62.12 deg, UGBW=101.8 MHz, SR=57.9 V/us, Gain=723.5 V/V, Noise=0.0140 V, Current=226.3uA, Area=7.635e-10 m^2. Handing over to Reviewer.

Final verified solution is Candidate 577 with FoM=0.6857 (feasible=true). Fully compliant with all 5 hard constraints: Gain=723.5 V/V, PM=62.12 deg, UGBW=101.8 MHz, SR=57.9 V/us, Noise=0.0140 V RMS, Current=226.3uA, Area=7.635e-10 m^2. Generated explanation.md.
